rank_context: Diamond Ana players generally understand basic mechanics and healing output, but plateau due to passive utility usage (defensive heal-nades instead of fight-winning anti-nades), wasting Sleep Dart before enemy dive commits, poor Nano Boost tempo/economy, and healbotting tanks instead of weaving damage.

rules.category: Biotic Grenade Value (生物手雷进攻转化率)
rules.timeline_condition: Count across match: ratio of Biotic Grenades used for offensive purple anti-heal (`offensive_anti`) vs defensive yellow heal (`defensive_heal` / `self_heal`).
rules.diagnostic_template: 在 [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio})，你将生物手雷用于{actual_target}，而非在接团期禁疗敌方前排/核心。整局你的进攻紫瓶占比仅为 {offensive_anti_pct}%（钻石进阶标准应 ≥ 50%）。
rules.actionable_fix: 当己方主T血量高于50%且有掩体时，用普通左键维持血线，把E技能（生物手雷）留到双方前排交火、敌方护盾/金身/铃铛交出后的窗口，优先砸向敌方前排或侧翼制造禁疗击杀点。

rules.category: Sleep Dart Discipline (睡眠针防切纪律)
rules.timeline_condition: Enemy composition contains dive/flank threat AND player fires Sleep Dart at range >15m at enemy frontline/tank (`poke_lottery_sleep`) AND player is dove or killed within 14 seconds while Sleep Dart is on cooldown.
rules.diagnostic_template: 在 [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio})，敌方存活威胁包含 {enemy_threats}，但你在 [{sleep_used_time}] 先把睡眠针远距离抽奖丢给了 {sleep_target}，导致 {seconds_later} 秒后被切入时睡眠针仍在CD（剩余 {cd_remaining}s）而阵亡。
rules.actionable_fix: 面对机动坦或狗位C位时，严禁开团前用睡眠针远距离摸奖敌方前排。只要敌方刺客/跳坦未露面或未交位移，睡眠针必须捏在手里作为唯一自保底牌。

rules.category: Nano Boost Fight Economy (纳米激素残局纪律与节奏)
rules.timeline_condition: Player activates Ultimate (Nano Boost) when `ally_alive - enemy_alive <= -2` (e.g., 3v5, 2v4) OR holds 100% Ultimate charge for > 90 seconds across lost/neutral fights.
rules.diagnostic_template: 在 [{timestamp}]，右上角击杀面板显示已处于 {alive_ratio}（核心队友 {dead_allies} 已阵亡），此时交出纳米激素给 {nano_target} 属于无效残局大招，直接导致下一波团战丧失大招经济优势。
rules.actionable_fix: 按Q前强制看一眼右上角击杀板：若己方已减员2人或主T已倒，立刻停手送死重整（Reset）；反之在5v5均势接团或4v4拉扯时，一旦队友进场即可果断交激素抢下先手减员，不要死等完美的拔刀/战术目镜配合。

rules.category: Healbot Tunnel Vision vs Damage Weaving (无效溢奶与输出穿插)
rules.timeline_condition: Player fires >= 4 consecutive shots into allies at >85% HP while enemy squishies/supports are visible in line of sight, OR remains hard-scoped > 3.5 seconds in open sightline.
rules.diagnostic_template: 在 [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio})，己方前排血量健康（>{ally_hp_pct}%），但你连续开镜纯奶队友长达 {duration}s，错失了三枪点残敌方暴露在掩体外的 {exposed_enemy} 的机会。
rules.actionable_fix: 钻石分段安娜不能只做‘擦屁股奶妈’。在队友没有暴毙风险（血量>70%）时，养成‘奶两枪、点敌方后排/侧翼一枪’的穿插节奏（70分1枪无衰减伤害只需3枪即可逼退或击杀敌方C位/辅助）。
